review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only bundle. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 preserve the read-only, computed size + pending contract and existing scheduling, event ordering, clear behavior, and microtask timing. The exact four-file binding scope matches the PRD and supplied implementation and regression owners without requiring gratuitous edits. The build configuration supports treating dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The supplied nz discovery and compiler-invocation evidence establishes a compile-time verification path for test-d/index.test-d.ts despite the production tsconfig including only source; runtime tests are not being substituted for type checking. Stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree. TASK-VERIFY remains independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with all required acceptance criteria requiring both relationships. The allowed implementer and verifier have the relevant active, project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change and integration.consumer, and the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The selected planning reviewer is compatible with the supplied independence policy. No material unresolved Decision is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; the B/DEC-001 and hypothetical C rules do not introduce decisions into this bundle. Repository identity and revision, source normalization and digest domains, team projection provenance, executing-bundle prompt fingerprint, and model, sampling, budget, and metric-policy fingerprints are consistent across the supplied frozen records. The original specification's remaining preparation fields describe its earlier preparation state, while the preview supplies the frozen release inputs. This approval uses only the supplied review evidence, with no candidate outputs, execution, new human attestation, or independent digest recomputation, and does not authorize implementation or dispatch.
